thread:
jamie: kicking off a 5% canary for model v3.1-int4-nf4 now. baseline v3.1-int8 p95=240ms, cost baseline=1.0x. expecting ~30% token-cost reduction with int4. :rocket:
akshay: noted. what slices are in the smoke set? long-context? multi-turn?
maria: ran quick slice eval — long-context (>=1024) p95 jumped to 520ms on int4 samples vs 260ms baseline. small-sample but worrying.
jamie: ugh. our global p95 drop still good (190ms), but long-context hit is real. important: MRR delta is -0.007 across eval set (threshold -0.005).
eva: hallucination checks? any change in hallucination rate?
maria: hallucination rate (precision of facts metric) increased from 0.4% -> 1.8% on one conversational slice. that's > auto-fallback hallucination threshold.
sam: ops-bot, can you patch the canary to pause traffic for the long-context slice and keep rest at 5%? ideally route long-context to int8 variant.
ops-bot: received. applying slice routing rule: `route(slice: "seqlen>=1024") -> v3.1-int8; default -> v3.1-int4 (5%)` :white_check_mark:
akshay: good mitigation. still want to run an A/B for user-visible quality with small population though -- can we run a quiet-burn on 1% with int8 vs int4 across the same traffic?
jamie: yes, start quiet-burn 1% split int4:int8, collect MRR, hallucination, and p95 by slice. hold auto-promotion.
maria: pushing eval job now. quick config snippet:
``` 
{ 
  "canary": { 
    "traffic": "5%", 
    "quieter_burn": "1%", 
    "slice_overrides": [{"name":"long-context","rule":"seqlen>=1024","target":"v3.1-int8"}] 
  }, 
  "fallback_thresholds": { 
    "mrr_delta": -0.005, 
    "hallucination_pct": 0.01, 
    "p95_latency_ms": 300 
  } 
} 
``` 
jak: (typo in config example above, ignore)
eva: heads-up — if quiet-burn shows MRR still below threshold but hallucination stable, we might accept slight MRR hit for cost. need biz signoff.
jamie: yes, will loop in product if mrr dip >0.5% after quiet-burn.
akshay: if quiet-burn passes, we can do progressive ramp: 5% -> 20% -> 50% with hysteresis (wait 2h and delta within thresholds). otherwise auto-fallback.
sam: logging question: include per-token cost logs and kv-cache hit rate in eval so we can explain cost/latency tradeoff.
maria: done. upload results ETA 25m.
jamie: thanks — if we see anything >threshold we rollback to v3.1-int8 for that slice and open a quick postmortem. :eyes:
